# Scoped guest

<!-- Generated by php artisan standards:install from tey/standards; do not edit. -->

Invite someone to act on ONE record, with no other access. Build your own; there is no generator yet.

No generator yet; follow the summary and stamp the file `standards-pattern: access-tenancy.membership.scoped-guest`.

Kit: none.
Checks: none. Run `php artisan standards:check --changed` before committing.

Conventions:
- A role with zero grants plus a scope row: record, membership, email, invited_by, revoked_at.
- ONE access class, used by routes, MCP tools and policies alike.
- MCP tokens are limited to the record.
- Feature-gated.
- Scoped guests NEVER appear as transfer, admin or role-picker targets, or in member lists.
- Revoke is immediate: it kills pending links and drops the guest membership on the last scope.
- Acceptance is audited.

Related: `access-tenancy.membership.workspace`, `access-tenancy.capability`.

Graduates: To become a Concierge feature (invitation scope, teylabs/concierge issue 133).

Not sure this is the right leaf? It answers "Who is being let in?" Call bakery.find, or run `php artisan standards:pattern --recipe=access-tenancy.membership.scoped-guest` to see its siblings.
